name: MSE 3002
title: Transport Phenomena in Materials Processing
description: Mechanisms and quantitative treatment of mass, energy, and momentum transfer will be applied to design and analysis of materials processing. Increasingly complex and open-ended engineering design projects will be used to illustrate principles of diffusion; heat conduction, convection, and radiation, and fluid flow.
requirement_description: MSE 3003 and MATH 2110Q, both of which may be taken concurrently.
